design: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent game spritesheet, ONE sheet with exactly four equal square cells in a 2x2 grid. Edit target/reference: supplied existing top-down four-engine mouse boss aircraft. Preserve its identity, top-down camera, nose pointing DOWN, gray gold materials, silhouette scale, lighting and centered pivot. Each cell contains entire same aircraft, centered at identical scale, transparent generous margins, NO labels or grid lines. Read order: top left damage stage 1 minor: scorched left outer engine, cracked left wing armor, mouse pilot visibly worried with raised brows and cyan sweat droplet; top right stage 2 medium: left outer engine broken casing, right wing scorched, exposed wires and chipped armor, mouse nervous sweating eyes wide; bottom left stage 3 severe: both outer engines broken, jagged missing wing tips, exposed inner machinery, pilot panicked sweating; bottom right stage 4 final damage: badly wrecked but recognizable core fuselage, torn wings and broken engine casings, mouse pilot VERY FURIOUS, red flushed face, deeply angled brows, teeth clenched and anger mark, no sweat. Keep pilot easy to read. Stylish polished 3D toy aircraft matching reference. Avoid opaque backgrounds, checkerboard, ground plane, smoke obscuring pilot, text, additional characters. Output actual alpha transparency, 1024x1024 or larger square sheet. All four craft same registered centered position and size per cell, aircraft fits within middle 80% of each cell.
status: Integrated; real RGBA generated by user-authorized local background extraction with sharp; browser QA passed.
